title: ResolutionRule
description: One step of a region's cost-resolution ladder: stock class -> origin of data -> supplier/COO/OOD -> cost basis -> fallback chain. Deliberately loose (additionalProperties: true) — the deck's four-region audit (slide 4) found four very different ladders (Americas MTS/non-MTS, China direct-vs-SAP-fallback, etc.) behind the same five primitives; forcing one rigid shape here would just push the variance into `when` expressions instead of removing it.

fallback.description: Ordered chain of rule ids or cost bases to fall back through.
